title: In 2021, billionaire Orlando Bravo paid $39.25 million for Phil Collins’s 1929 Miami Beach mansion
summary_full: Orlando Bravo has received approval to tear down a historic estate in Miami Beach that was once the home of Phil Collins. This demolition paves the way for a new luxury mansion, purposefully designed to combat flooding. The choice has ignited discussions about the importance of preserving historical sites in South Florida, with many advocates worried about the potential loss of early 20th-century architecture as climate challenges mount.
